title: Trust Document Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Trust documents (`trust:document`), will status logs (`will:status`), power-of-attorney records (`poa:record`), and estate review sessions (`estate:review`).
app: Trust document vault exports, will status trackers, power-of-attorney records, and estate review checklists forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=trust:document
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by document_type
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>720
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when trust document data has stopped arriving for a given document type.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per document type and alert when the feed is older than 720 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It logs when one part of your trust document feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
